purpose: Increase coverage using outcome definitions and conventional outcome ordering, without assigning net welfare or observing reported results.

semantic_safeguards.reason: Group composition lacks an absolute-benefit ordering. Reporting/activity flags require accompanying outcome ambiguity, because registry-based harm, beneficial access and direct beneficiary burdens can still have a conventional direction. Introduced after result-blind substantive review; not an independently validated error model.

context: Outcome-relevant paragraphs from data, measurement and institutional-setting sections only; no abstract, introduction, results, conclusion, table inputs, numerical effects, standard errors or ratings.
validation: Paired comparisons and AI-assisted substantive audit; no independently calibrated false-positive or false-negative rates are claimed.
